milestone.title: Make install: delegate to mp install + v1 harness trio (OpenCode, Cursor, Pi)

intent.outcome: Contributors run make install and get the exact same artifact tree, doctor checks, and remediation hints as mp install --dev --source <repo> --harness opencode,cursor,pi. v1 default install targets three harnesses: OpenCode, Cursor, and Pi (pi.dev). The Makefile is a thin build-and-invoke wrapper — no duplicated copy logic, harness paths, or shell rc guessing.

problem.description: M51/M56 shipped mp install as the canonical install engine (binaries, env.sh, spec-grill, convention files, harness registry). make install still reimplements a parallel path with parity drift (no env.sh, stale PATH notes). Separately, pi is in the harness registry but with incorrect paths (~/.pi/skills/ vs official ~/.pi/agent/skills/) and wrong convention file (.pirules vs AGENTS.md at ~/.pi/agent/). Pi natively discovers ~/.agents/skills/ (shared with OpenCode) but also ~/.pi/agent/skills/ and loads global AGENTS.md from ~/.pi/agent/AGENTS.md. v1 install docs and make install only target OpenCode + Cursor. User request: from M74 onward, default install supports opencode, cursor, and pi.

in_scope: Makefile refactor: install targets call target/release/mp install/uninstall with --harness opencode,cursor,pi for default make install
Fix pi harness registry paths per pi.dev docs: global skills at ~/.pi/agent/skills/, project at .pi/skills/, global AGENTS.md at ~/.pi/agent/AGENTS.md (replace incorrect ~/.pi/skills/ and .pirules)
Extend HarnessDescriptor if needed: separate convention_path from skill_dir (pi convention lives in agent root, not under skill dir)
Deploy master-planner + spec-grill to pi native paths on mp install --harness pi; note ~/.agents/skills/ overlap with OpenCode (document, do not duplicate canonical skill source)
make install-pi target (or install-opencode,cursor,pi split targets) mirroring mp install --harness pi
scripts/install-summary.sh: human-friendly output from install JSON (path_snippet, doctor checks, harness list including pi)
mp install --toolkit-only flag if install-global must remain skills-free
Parity integration test: make install vs mp install --harness opencode,cursor,pi
make uninstall delegates to mp uninstall --purge
Update INSTALL.md, ADOPTION-CHECKLIST.md, README.md, AGENTS.md, master-planner skill compatibility section for Pi (skills + AGENTS.md + env.sh; link pi.dev docs)
Remove stale install-cursor note and double build-release
Doctor checks for pi harness: skill at ~/.pi/agent/skills/master-planner/SKILL.md, AGENTS.md at ~/.pi/agent/AGENTS.md when pi in installed harness set
out_of_scope: Pi extensions (~/.pi/agent/extensions/) — skills-only integration for v1; extensions are user-authored TypeScript modules
Pi npm/git package install (pi install command) — we deploy flat SKILL.md trees, not pi packages
Other registry harnesses (claude-code, gemini, codex, windsurf, cline) — remain in registry but not v1 default install
Changing mp install CLI default from opencode (make install passes explicit opencode,cursor,pi)

acceptance_criteria.description: make install deploys env.sh, bin/raul, spec-grill, and master-planner for opencode+cursor+pi — parity with mp install --dev --source <repo> --harness opencode,cursor,pi
Pi harness registry paths match pi.dev: ~/.pi/agent/skills/master-planner/SKILL.md, ~/.pi/agent/AGENTS.md convention, .pi/skills/ project path; doctor verifies when pi harness installed
make uninstall removes the same artifacts mp uninstall --purge would remove from a make install
make install output reflects doctor PATH status (no unconditional not-on-PATH when mp resolves on PATH)
Makefile contains no manual cp of mp/raul/templates to INSTALL_DIR; install targets invoke TARGET only
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Makefile delegates to mp install only

acceptance_criteria.description: INSTALL.md documents OpenCode, Cursor, and Pi harness setup; README and skill template link to valid doc paths
acceptance_criteria.evidence: INSTALL.md README ADOPTION-CHECKLIST skill Pi trio

design_decisions.choice: Bootstrap: make build-release then $(TARGET) install — not circular
design_decisions.rationale: Makefile is orchestration only; mp install is single source of truth
Ensures fresh target/release binaries and repo asset tree, not stale global mp

design_decisions.choice: Human install UX via scripts/install-summary.sh parsing JSON
design_decisions.rationale: M41 keeps mp JSON-only; thin shell wrapper avoids expanding mp output surface for dev-repo path

design_decisions.choice: v1 default install harness set: opencode, cursor, pi (not all 8 registry entries)
design_decisions.rationale: User-facing v1 targets three harnesses; others remain in registry for mp install --harness but are not make install defaults

design_decisions.choice: Pi skills at ~/.pi/agent/skills/; conventions at ~/.pi/agent/AGENTS.md per pi.dev
design_decisions.rationale: Current registry uses wrong paths (~/.pi/skills/, .pirules); pi loads AGENTS.md from agent root and skills from agent/skills or ~/.agents/skills/

design_decisions.choice: Pi extensions out of scope — skills-only v1 integration
design_decisions.rationale: Extensions are TypeScript modules in ~/.pi/agent/extensions/; master-planner is an Agent Skill (SKILL.md), not an extension
